observations.footwork: Fighters are moving laterally, crossing paths. The fighter on the left steps to the right while the fighter on the right steps to the left.
observations.guard: Both maintain a guard with hands up.
observations.upper_body: Torsos are upright; minimal arm movement, mostly footwork.
observations.distance: Start in opposite corners, close the distance as they pass.

observations.footwork: One fighter steps forward to close the gap. After the punch, they remain in position.
observations.guard: Guard is maintained, with the attacking fighter briefly opening the lead hand.
observations.upper_body: At F10, a punch is thrown from the fighter on the left, with the arm extended toward the opponent.
observations.distance: Close range; the fighters are within striking distance.

observations.footwork: Fighters reset and continue with short, controlled steps.
observations.upper_body: At F14, another punch is thrown by the same fighter on the left.
observations.notable: A second punch attempt occurs (F14); the sequence ends with both returning to guard.

movement_events.detail: The fighter on the left moves across the frame toward the right.
The fighter on the right steps in, reducing the distance.
The fighter on the left extends a punch toward the opponent.
The punch is retracted back to guard.
Fighters reset to their starting stances.
The fighter on the left begins to load a punch.
The fighter on the left extends a punch again.
The punch is retracted as the sequence ends.
